hints.title: Paired Removals
hints.text: Pairing each character with the nearest preceding non-digit character resolves removals.

hints.title: Digit Processing
hints.text: For each character in s, if it is a digit, pop the top character from the stack; otherwise, push the character.

hints.title: String Assembly
hints.text: Join the remaining characters in the stack to form the result string.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Every character is pushed and popped at most once.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeated string splicing takes O(n^2) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use a stack to model paired deletions in linear time.
